thread:
Liz R (support): Heads-up: Acme reported their embeddings are throwing a dimension error after we ran the model catalog upgrade for the pinned endpoint. They say previously embeddings were 1536 and now calls return 1024. Panic in their app.
Maria S (support): Ugh. Do we have the upgrade job id/which model variant was rolled?
Liz R (support): They pasted the request/response. Root thread ts 1768203456. Here's the failure payload they sent: 
```json
POST /v1/embeddings
{
  \"model\": \"embed-legacy-1536\",
  \"input\": [\"some text\"]
}

HTTP/1.1 200 OK
{
  \"data\": [{
    \"embedding\": [0.12, ...]  // length 1024
  }],
  \"model\": \"embed-open-1.0\"
}
```
They pinned `embed-legacy-1536` in their config but we apparently routed to `embed-open-1.0` during the catalog swap.
Jason M (ml-engineer): That matches a routing fallback bug we patched earlier but thought we had safe guards for pinned endpoints. Could be a model alias mapping that got updated.
Binh T (infra): deploy-bot shows a catalog merge at 1768201200 that replaced aliases: `embed-legacy-1536 -> embed-open-1.0` in the global catalog. Pinned configs are supposed to lock mappings.
Maria S (support): Customer is asking for immediate mitigation. Options: 1) rollback catalog mapping 2) pin to explicit model id (not alias) 3) run a compatibility shim to upconvert 1024->1536 (terrible).
Jason M (ml-engineer): We should confirm whether the model actually changed vector size for `embed-open-1.0`. I can query the model metadata API: 
```bash
curl -s -H \"Authorization: Bearer $KEY\" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/models/embed-open-1.0/metadata
```
Should return `embedding_dimensions`.
Liz R (support): Customer posted their quick repro curl. They used our SDK with model name `embed-legacy-1536` (alias). I'll paste: 
```bash
curl https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \n -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN\" \n -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \n -d '{"model":"embed-legacy-1536","input":["foo"]}'
```
Response shows `model: embed-open-1.0` and array of length 1024.
Maria S (support): Customer asks if their pinned endpoint should be immune from alias rewrites. We need to be explicit in reply. I'll draft: \"We are investigating. For immediate fix, temporarily update your integration to use `embed-legacy-1536:rev-42` (explicit model revision) or we can rollback the catalog entry on our side.\" Thoughts?
Jason M (ml-engineer): Good. Also add a quick script they can run to verify dims locally: 
```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client(os.environ['REDWOOD_KEY'])
resp = client.embeddings.create(model='embed-legacy-1536', input=['test'])
print(len(resp.data[0].embedding))
```
This will show 1024 vs 1536.
Binh T (infra): I can roll back the alias mapping for the customer sub-account. We need ticket approval from security/product for a targeted rollback. If we get sign-off I can perform the rollback within 10m.
Liz R (support): I'll ask Acme to hold on changes and give them the quick workaround (explicit revision) while we get approvals. Do we want to auto-detect mismatched dims and return a 409 or a warning? Right now the app silently accepts the vector and then their downstream indexer fails.
Jason M (ml-engineer): We should also add a server-side warning header when a pinned model alias resolves to a different embedding dim than the pinned revision. E.g., `x-embed-dim: expected=1536; got=1024`. Low effort and helps customers triage. I'll file a small follow-up.
Maria S (support): Customer also reported throughput drop because they batched expecting 1536 vecs; their sharded index pipeline errored out. I'll add that to the ticket under impact.
Liz R (support): OK actions: 1) Maria to send customer immediate workaround + ask for permission for rollback 2) Binh to prep rollback change and timeline 3) Jason to confirm model metadata dims and add header proposal 4) I will coordinate with product/security for rollback approval.
Binh T (infra): Taking action: prepping rollback PR and can toggle alias once approved. ETA 15m after greenlight.
deploy-bot: catalog-merge detected at 1768201200 by release-ci — aliases updated: embed-legacy-1536 -> embed-open-1.0
Jason M (ml-engineer): Metadata check: embed-open-1.0 embedding_dimensions=1024, embed-legacy-1536 (revision rev-42) embedding_dimensions=1536. Confirmed mismatch.
Liz R (support): Thanks all. Maria I'll post the workaround to the customer now: use explicit revision or we can rollback. Will update thread when we hear back. :thumbsup:
Maria S (support): Posted workaround, customer responded "please rollback". Waiting on Product approval.
Liz R (support): Product approved targeted rollback. Binh, execute when ready.
Binh T (infra): Rolling back alias for Acme account now. Will monitor their ingest for errors.
deploy-bot: alias-toggle completed at 1768203799 by infra-deployer
Liz R (support): Customer confirmed after the rollback their indexer stopped erroring and counts match 1536. Closing loop and will follow up on header proposal and stronger pinned guarantees.
Maria S (support): Adding postmortem tags and linking docs on pinned vs alias semantics.
Jason M (ml-engineer): Follow-up ticket created: PROD-1234 \"Embed alias->revision mismatch and pinned-resilience\".
Liz R (support): Great job team. Keeping thread open for a few hours for monitoring.
